title: It’s good but….
body: I find the app really helpful but I have one problem i already created account and wanted to apply for 1 free year - program as I’m unable to afford I submitted the form for it with the email i used for the free trial it even asked me to click on agreement but I didn’t get any mail or anything mentioning about the free one year what went wrong ?
author: Itzrichi

title: Make payment plans clear
body:
I think it’s ridiculous that you make someone fill up detailed forms, sign up and verify email IDs only to lead them to a page for payment first. You need to make it clear at the beginning and share the payments plans before someone invests their time in this. 

It just seems like you want to collect data.
author: Esskay20

title: Bad Onboarding experience
body: Why are you talking through a long onboarding process and then saying app is paid. If App is paid no issues but let me know earlier. Bad UX
